problems.statement:
Write the observational program for this night on a 40-cm telescope. What stars would you observe this night? Write sequence of the observations.

Stars to observe:

| | Star | $V$ (mag) | $\alpha$ | $\delta$ (1950) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | $\eta$ Aql | $3.5$ | $19^{\mathrm h}49.9^{\mathrm m}$ | $0^\circ53'$ |
| 2 | $\beta$ Per | $2.1$ | $3^{\mathrm h}04.9^{\mathrm m}$ | $40^\circ46'$ |
| 3 | $\chi$ Cyg | $14.2$ | $19^{\mathrm h}48.6^{\mathrm m}$ | $32^\circ47'$ |
| 4 | R Aqr | $12.4$ | $23^{\mathrm h}41.2^{\mathrm m}$ | $-15^\circ34'$ |
| 5 | $\alpha$ Ori | $1.3$ | $5^{\mathrm h}52.4^{\mathrm m}$ | $7^\circ24'$ |
| 6 | RW Vir | $6.7$ | $12^{\mathrm h}04.7^{\mathrm m}$ | $-6^\circ29'$ |

Moon rise: 21:17:26, phase 0.77.

Sideral time for $0^{\mathrm h}$: $s_0=0{:}31{:}04$.

You may use all observational time (since $20^{\mathrm h}$ till $5^{\mathrm h}30\,\mathrm{min}$).

Local time $\mathrm{LT}=\mathrm{UT}+3$.

Coordinates of observatory $\lambda=2^{\mathrm h}16^{\mathrm m}$, $\varphi=44^\circ43'$.
